## Tours to Manto de la Novia Waterfall: Baños and the Waterfall Route

[Manto de la Novia](/ecuador/place/manto-de-la-novia-waterfall/), meaning *Bride's Veil*, is a waterfall on the road from [Baños](/ecuador/place/banos/) toward Puyo. A bright ribbon of falling water stands out against the green slopes of the Pastaza River gorge. Nearby is a *tarabita*, a suspended cable crossing that offers views of the waterfall from above.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} featuring Manto de la Novia in their main itinerary. Most visit it on the same day as [Agoyán](/ecuador/place/agoyan-waterfall/) and [Pailón del Diablo, the Devil's Cauldron](/ecuador/place/pailon-del-diablo-waterfall/). The itineraries differ considerably in duration and where travelers go after Baños.

## Which Tours Visit the Waterfall?

| Itinerary | What to know |
|---|---|
| [Active Ecuador and Trekking](/ecuador/tour/active-ecuador-trekking/) | 13 days; waterfalls on day 11 |
| [Ecuador and Galápagos Adventure Tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/) | 17 days; nature activities |
| [Best of Ecuador](/ecuador/tour/best-of-ecuador-guaranteed-departures/) | 11 days; overview itinerary |
| [Ecuador: Nature Reserves and Galápagos](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/) | 14 days; Baños, Mashpi, islands |

On the [13-day Active Ecuador and Trekking tour](/ecuador/tour/active-ecuador-trekking/), travelers visit Baños and the waterfalls on day 11. Agoyán, Manto de la Novia and the Devil's Cauldron are planned, while a canopy activity above the Pastaza Canyon is offered as a separate experience.

On the [17-day adventure tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/), the waterfall day also falls on day 11. After exploring Baños, the route continues to Riobamba; the entire excursion day, including transfers, takes approximately 8–9 hours.

[Best of Ecuador: Guaranteed Departures](/ecuador/tour/best-of-ecuador-guaranteed-departures/) includes the waterfalls on day 4, specifically mentioning the crossing at Manto de la Novia. The [14-day nature reserve tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/) combines this area with [Mashpi](/ecuador/place/mashpi-reserve/) and the Galápagos.

## How Visitors See the Waterfall

Manto de la Novia is roughly 11 km from Baños. It can be viewed from roadside viewpoints, the suspended *tarabita* crossing, or one of the walking approaches. According to the Río Verde administration and local tourism resources, some routes involve a bridge and steps, so the difficulty depends on the chosen viewing point.

**The cable crossing and a canopy activity are separate services.** The *tarabita* crosses the gorge and gives views of the waterfall. A canopy tour is a different, more extreme activity. On some of our tours, canopy activities cost extra; including the waterfall on the itinerary does not make them an included service.

The Waterfall Route follows the Pastaza River through green slopes and rocky stretches. After stopping at one cascade, travelers often continue to another, so transfer times affect the entire day. Consider the full sequence of visits and the return to the hotel rather than simply counting the waterfalls listed in a tour's title.

## When to Visit and What to Bring

The Baños area is humid, with rain and mist possible. Spray can soak visitors near the cascades. Closed-toe shoes with nonslip soles, a raincoat, and protection for your camera or phone are recommended. Access to the cable crossing and individual trails depends on local conditions.

For active adventures, explore our [Adventure travel](/interests/adventure/) routes. To discover several natural regions of Ecuador, compare the [general tour catalog](/ecuador/tour/). The [Baños page](/ecuador/place/banos/) provides more information about the area itself.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Manto de la Novia Tours

### Can I See the Waterfall Without a Long Hike?

Yes. It is close to the road along the Waterfall Route. Some viewpoints require steps or a cable crossing, however, so check the difficulty of the particular program.

### Are the Tarabita and Canopy Activities Included on Every Tour?

No. Arrangements differ. Some itineraries include the cable crossing as part of the visit, while canopy activities are listed as an extra paid option.

### How Does Manto de la Novia Differ from Pailón del Diablo?

They are separate waterfalls. [Manto de la Novia](/ecuador/place/manto-de-la-novia-waterfall/) is known for its bright ribbon of falling water and cable crossing, while [Pailón del Diablo](/ecuador/place/pailon-del-diablo-waterfall/) is famous for its powerful flow and rocky walking approaches.

### Are There Itineraries Including the Galápagos?

Yes, including the [17-day adventure tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/) and a [14-day itinerary](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/).

## Mashpi: A Cloud Forest Near Quito

Mashpi Reserve lies northwest of [Quito](/ecuador/place/quito-and-cotopaxi-volcano/), on the humid western slopes of the Andes. Instead of open high-altitude landscapes, the scenery here is dense greenery, ferns, moss, orchids and trees shrouded in clouds. Mashpi belongs to the ecosystems of the Chocó bioregion, known for its diversity of plants, birds and amphibians.

Mashpi's natural environment is difficult to appreciate from a single panorama. Much of the forest's life is spread across different heights: some organisms live in the undergrowth, others in the canopy. Excursions therefore revolve around trails, viewpoints and guided observations, with a naturalist helping visitors spot birds and small animals.

## Why Is Mashpi Called a Cloud Forest?

Cloud forest develops where moist air rises along a mountainside and frequently forms low clouds. Droplets settle on leaves, tree trunks and epiphytic plants. The forest remains damp for long periods even when it is not raining on a particular trail.

In Mashpi you can see trees covered in moss and bromeliads, large ferns, streams and small waterfalls. Bird and amphibian calls carry clearly through the dense vegetation. Watching wildlife requires a quiet pace: a colorful toucan or hummingbird is easier to notice when you stop than when you hurry along the path.

Mashpi Lodge's conservation materials describe scientific monitoring of birds, butterflies, amphibians and other groups of organisms in the private reserve. Research is an important part of its purpose: tourist trails and ecosystem studies coexist here. Some species are rarely encountered, so specific sightings cannot be promised in advance.

## What Can You Do in Mashpi?

The main activity is walking along forest trails with a guide. Routes differ in gradient, moisture, distance and the nature of their ascents. Some lead to waterfalls and streams; others focus on birdwatching and the upper forest layers.

Mashpi Lodge also describes special ways to experience the forest, including observation platforms, a butterfly observation center, the Dragonfly gondola above the canopy and other activities. **Their presence at the lodge does not mean they are automatically included in every Ada Tours itinerary.** The timing, availability and cost of each activity must be checked against the chosen accommodation program.

For someone discovering the humid forest for the first time, a trail with several stops and explanations from a local guide is a good choice. Photographers need protection from moisture and should be prepared to work in low light beneath the canopy. Binoculars are useful for bird lovers, and shoes with good grip are important for walking.

## How to Get There and How Much Time to Allow

Mashpi Lodge is located in the Pacto area within Quito's metropolitan district. The lodge's official description gives approximate figures of a 3-hour drive and an elevation of around 950 meters above sea level. The road descends from higher Andean terrain into the humid forest belt. Travel time depends on your departure point and road conditions.

Allow enough time for at least one full nature experience in Mashpi rather than simply driving to the hotel for a quick stop. Early morning may be good for birdwatching, while later in the day you can walk to streams or a viewpoint, depending on weather and the selected route.

On the [9-day Ecuador tour featuring Mashpi and the Galápagos](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-quito-cotopaxi-mashpi-galapagos-9-days/), Mashpi is one stage between Quito and the islands. Accommodation at Mashpi Lodge and guided walks are included, with the exact activities arranged according to forest conditions. An [18-day Peru and Ecuador journey](/multi-country/tour/peru-ecuador-galapagos-luxury-18-days/) has a separate Mashpi stage with a stay at the lodge. The length of the stay and particular activities differ between these products.

## Mashpi, Mindo or the Amazon: Which to Choose?

[Mindo](/ecuador/place/mindo/) is also known for the humid forests on the western slopes of the Andes and birdwatching. Yet it is a different area with its own trails and facilities. Similar habitats do not make the excursions interchangeable.

[Cuyabeno](/ecuador/place/cuyabeno-reserve/) and [Yasuní](/ecuador/place/yasuni-national-park/) are Amazonian lowland areas, where rivers, long boat journeys and flooded forests play a major role. Mashpi is closer to Quito and allows visitors to focus on cloud forest and the vertical structure of its vegetation.

| Place | Type of experience |
|---|---|
| Mashpi | Cloud forest, trails, canopy observation |
| [Mindo](/ecuador/place/mindo/) | Forest walks, birds |
| [Cuyabeno](/ecuador/place/cuyabeno-reserve/) | River-based Amazon exploration, lagoons |

Consider elevation when selecting a tour: Mashpi lies considerably lower than Quito, but the road involves descents and bends through the mountains. Humidity and trail conditions may change over the course of the day.

## Preparing for Forest Walks

A raincoat, lightweight long-sleeved clothing and shoes with good grip are more useful than heavy city clothes. Bring protection against moisture for your camera and binoculars for wildlife observation. Stay with your guide on the trails and avoid touching plants or animals.

If your main interest is forest wildlife, choose a program according to the number of actual excursions and time spent on the trails. Our [nature travel section](/interests/wildlife/) can help you compare different approaches: Mashpi's cloud forest, Andean ecosystems and Amazonian reserves require different ways of visiting.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Mashpi

### Where Is Mashpi Reserve Located?

Northwest of Quito, on the western slopes of the Andes in the Chocó region. The drive to Mashpi Lodge usually takes about 3 hours.

### Is Mashpi Part of the Amazon?

No. Mashpi is part of the humid forests of the western Andean slopes, whereas Ecuador's Amazonian lowlands lie east of the Andes.

### Can You See Birds and Butterflies?

Yes. Guided nature walks and observation activities are offered. Specific species and the number of sightings depend on nature and weather.

### Is the Gondola Ride Above the Canopy Included in Every Tour?

No. The option to take the Dragonfly gondola or join other special activities must be checked against the selected accommodation and itinerary.

### Can You Combine Mashpi with the Galápagos?

Yes. That combination is included in an [existing Ecuador tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-quito-cotopaxi-mashpi-galapagos-9-days/). Allow time for the road transfer from Quito and a separate flight to the islands.

## Tours Through Mashpi Reserve in Ecuador

[Mashpi](/ecuador/place/mashpi-reserve/) lies in the humid Andean Chocó northwest of [Quito](/ecuador/place/quito-and-cotopaxi-volcano/). Here the mountain slopes are covered with cloud forest, ferns and orchids, while streams and small waterfalls flow through dense vegetation. Travelers come for forest walks, birdwatching and time surrounded by tropical nature.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. When choosing, the **length of the forest portion itself** matters most. Some itineraries allot about two days to Mashpi between visits to other regions, while others provide 3 days and 2 nights at Mashpi Lodge.

## Which Itineraries Visit Mashpi?

| Tour | Nature program |
|---|---|
| [Quito, Cotopaxi, Mashpi, Galápagos: 9 Days](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-quito-cotopaxi-mashpi-galapagos-9-days/) | Short forest stay |
| [Ecuador and Galápagos: Protected Natural Areas](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/) | 3 days in Mashpi |
| [VIP Peru and Ecuador: 18 Days](/multi-country/tour/peru-ecuador-galapagos-luxury-18-days/) | Mashpi between Peru and the islands |

On the [9-day itinerary](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-quito-cotopaxi-mashpi-galapagos-9-days/), travelers leave Quito on day 4, visit the Pululahua area and the Tulipe archaeological site on the way, then arrive at Mashpi. After exploring the forest and a morning activity the following day, they return to the capital and continue to the islands.

On the [14-day nature reserve tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/), Mashpi occupies days 6–8. One day is devoted to arrival, the next to the main nature program, and the third to a final activity and the drive to Quito. This schedule allows forest observation in the morning and evening as well as time to relax.

Mashpi Lodge is allotted a 3-day, 2-night program. The [18-day VIP itinerary](/multi-country/tour/peru-ecuador-galapagos-luxury-18-days/) also includes Mashpi as one of several major nature stages on a journey through two countries.

## How Mashpi Differs from Other Ecuadorian Forests

Mashpi belongs to the Andean Chocó region. Cloud forest and warmer humid forest communities occur here, and observations take place both on trails near the ground and from points higher up the slopes. According to Mashpi Lodge's research project, the area is known for its diversity of birds, amphibians and plants. However, sightings of any particular rare species cannot be guaranteed on a single walk.

The lodge offers nature excursions and different ways to explore the forest. Its wider list of activities is not the same as the content of each travel program: an activity being available at the hotel **does not mean it is automatically included in every Ada Tours price**.

Mashpi is conveniently reached from the capital, but the mountain road and stops take time. Several of our itineraries estimate the journey at approximately 3 hours. The actual duration depends on road conditions and the route for the day.

## How Many Days Should You Spend in the Forest?

For a brief introduction, choose a 9-day tour of Ecuador and the Galápagos. If you want more time in the forest, consider a program with 2 nights. This gives you more opportunities for walks, birdwatching, photography and rest when the weather changes.

Conditions are humid, so closed-toe shoes with nonslip soles, long-sleeved clothing and a raincoat are useful. Choose forest trails to suit participants' fitness, ground conditions and the advice of local nature guides.

To compare Mashpi with another cloud forest, see the [Bellavista page](/ecuador/place/bellavista-cloud-forest/). Find more forest and landscape itineraries in our [Nature section](/interests/nature/) and [Ecuador tour catalog](/ecuador/tour/). For journeys featuring planned wildlife or bird observations, browse [Safaris and Wildlife Watching](/interests/wildlife/): visiting a cloud forest does not by itself mean the program includes dedicated birdwatching.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours Through Mashpi

### Is Mashpi in the Amazon?

No. Mashpi lies in the western Andes, in the Chocó region. Ecuador's Amazonian areas lie on the other side of the Andes.

### Is One Night in Mashpi Enough?

Yes for a short introduction, but 2 nights offer more time for forest excursions and birdwatching. That arrangement is included in the [14-day itinerary](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-nature-discovery/).

### Are All Mashpi Lodge Services Included?

Not necessarily. Excursions, meals and additional activities depend on the specific Ada Tours itinerary.

### Can Sightings of Rare Animals Be Guaranteed?

No. This is a wild natural environment, so observations depend on weather and the animals' behavior.

## Mindo, Ecuador: Cloud Forest, Hummingbirds and Nature Trails

Mindo is a settlement and surrounding area of humid forest on the western slopes of the Ecuadorian Andes, northwest of [Quito](/ecuador/place/quito-and-cotopaxi-volcano/). The scenery contrasts sharply with the high-altitude volcanic plains: open grasslands give way to mist-shrouded trees, dense vegetation, rivers and humid air. This change in natural conditions is what makes Mindo one of [Ecuador's](/ecuador/) most interesting areas for bird lovers and forest walkers.

Mindo is often described as a cloud forest destination. Clouds and mist linger among the slopes, sustaining a humid environment. This supports a wealth of plants and animals, while views of some areas may open up for just a few minutes between banks of mist.

## Birds and Hummingbirds: Mindo's Main Attraction

Mindo is well known for birdwatching. Visitors observe hummingbirds, tanagers, toucans and other inhabitants of the humid Andean forest. Among the especially interesting species is the Andean cock-of-the-rock; sightings require choosing the right place and time. The Mindo Cloudforest Foundation works to protect the Andean Chocó forests and develop birdwatching as a form of conservation-focused tourism.

An experienced guide, quiet behavior and an early start are the most important ingredients of a good walk. Sometimes birds can be seen around feeding plants or from equipped observation points; at other times, patient waiting in the forest is necessary. A camera with a telephoto lens helps you observe while keeping your distance. The fact that a bird lives in the area does not guarantee it will appear at a particular hour.

## Waterfalls, Butterflies and Adventure Activities

Besides birdwatching, visitors to Mindo choose walks to waterfalls, trails along suspended walkways and visits to facilities introducing local butterfly species. The terrain can be wet and slippery; check trail length and elevation gain before setting out.

Canopy tours, tubing and other active experiences are also offered in the area. Each requires separate consideration of weather, physical fitness and the operator's arrangements. If your goal is a gentle forest walk with bird photography, adventure sports are entirely optional.

| Trip objective | What to choose |
|---|---|
| Birds | An early forest walk |
| Forest | Trails and waterfalls |
| Butterflies | A dedicated butterfly garden |
| Adventure | A separate activity |

## Mindo on Ada Tours Itineraries

On our [“Active Ecuador and Trekking” tour](/ecuador/tour/active-ecuador-trekking/), you visit Mindo early in the itinerary: day 2 is a Quito–Mindo–Quito outing. The program then turns to higher-altitude areas and mountain routes. You spend time on a forest walk and zipline course; tubing is optional, and there is no extended stay in the cloud forest. This tour falls under the Adventure and Nature themes, but it does not advertise a dedicated birdwatching outing with additional time reserved for observation.

Alternatively, you can spend several days in Mindo to enjoy multiple early-morning observation sessions and leave time for waterfalls. Compare forest and landscape itineraries in [Ecuador tours](/ecuador/tour/) and the [Nature section](/interests/nature/). For targeted birdwatching, browse [Wildlife and Safaris](/interests/wildlife/) and check exactly where and how much time each itinerary devotes to observations.

## Preparing for Your Trip

Humidity here is higher than in an open Andean valley. Closed-toe shoes with nonslip soles, a lightweight waterproof jacket and protection for electronics are suitable for walks. Drinking water and insect repellent are useful in the forest.

The drive from Quito crosses mountainous terrain; travel time depends on weather and traffic. If you want to watch birds at dawn, staying overnight in the area may be more convenient than setting out very early from the capital.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Mindo

### Is Mindo in the Amazon?

No. Mindo lies on the western slopes of the Andes, in the cloud forests of the Andean Chocó. This is a different natural region from the Amazon Basin.

### Can You Visit Mindo on a Day Trip from Quito?

Yes. This format is available and features in an existing Ada Tours itinerary. For more in-depth birdwatching and several nature routes, allow more time.

### What Is Mindo Famous For?

Its cloud forests, great diversity of birds—especially hummingbirds—as well as waterfalls and nature walks.

## Tours Through Mindo: Choosing an Ecuador Cloud Forest Itinerary

[Mindo](/ecuador/place/mindo/) lies in the western Ecuadorian Andes, where humid cloud forest replaces open highland slopes. Travelers come to watch birds, walk through dense vegetation and discover orchids and butterflies. From [Quito](/ecuador/place/quito-and-cotopaxi-volcano/), you can visit and return to the capital the same day, but longer itineraries offer a very different way to experience nature.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} that visit Mindo. **The main difference is how much time you spend in the forest and which activities are included in the specific program.** Ziplining, tubing, chocolate tasting or rare-bird observation in one itinerary does not mean these are included in the others.

## A Short Outing or Several Days in Cloud Forest?

| Itinerary | Mindo highlight |
|---|---|
| [Private Ecuador in 5 Days](/ecuador/tour/mainland-ecuador-private-tour-5-days/) | Butterflies, a walk, orchids, chocolate |
| [Complete Ecuador and Galápagos](/ecuador/tour/complete-ecuador-galapagos-islands/) | Forest and excursions in one day |
| [Ecuador, Quilotoa, Mindo and Galápagos](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-quito-quilotoa-mindo-july/) | Nature stop before the islands |
| [Active Ecuador and Trekking](/ecuador/tour/active-ecuador-trekking/) | Forest walk and zipline |
| [Ecuador and Galápagos Adventure Tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/) | Forest, zipline, optional activities |
| [Ecuador and the Amazon in 15 Days](/ecuador/tour/mainland-ecuador-amazon-15-days/) | Days in Bellavista and Mindo |
| [Andean and Amazonian Wildlife](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-wildlife/) | Forest walks and birdwatching |
| [Ecuador with a Galápagos Cruise](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-wildlife-cruise-18-days/) | Bellavista, Mindo and the island stage |

On the [5-day private itinerary](/ecuador/tour/mainland-ecuador-private-tour-5-days/), Mindo is visited on day 3. The route passes the [Pululahua](/ecuador/place/pululahua/) viewpoint and then includes a butterfly farm, forest walk, orchids and an introduction to chocolate making. This is a convenient option when you have limited time on mainland Ecuador.

On the [13-day active itinerary](/ecuador/tour/active-ecuador-trekking/), the Mindo outing takes place on day 2. A forest walk and zipline are included; tubing on a mountain river is described as an optional activity after lunch, which is paid for separately. The [17-day adventure tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/) likewise combines forest and ziplining with subsequent activities in the Andes and Galápagos. When selecting such a trip, evaluate not only this day but also the physical demands of later mountain stages.

The [15-day Ecuador and Amazon journey](/ecuador/tour/mainland-ecuador-amazon-15-days/) puts the emphasis elsewhere. Day 7 features accommodation and walks in [Bellavista Cloud Forest](/ecuador/place/bellavista-cloud-forest/), while day 8 begins with an early outing to watch cocks-of-the-rock, followed by a forest hike to Escondida Waterfall and a visit to Mindo. The [18-day journey including a cruise](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-wildlife-cruise-18-days/) also allocates separate days to Bellavista and Mindo. These are richer options for travelers who value morning wildlife observation and hiking trails rather than a brief sightseeing stop.

## What Is Really Worth Comparing?

**Time in the forest.** A day trip from Quito includes driving in both directions. On the active 13-day tour, for example, approximately 10 hours are allocated to the entire outing, with a one-way drive of about 2 hours. Multi-day programs reduce the time lost returning to the capital and allow you to start a trail in the morning.

**Wildlife observation.** Cloud forests are known for hummingbirds, cocks-of-the-rock and many other birds. Sightings depend on the time of day, weather and animal behavior, however; no particular bird can be promised to every guest. For dedicated birdwatching, compare itineraries with early starts and local nature guides. This format is covered more broadly by [Ecuador wildlife tours](/interests/wildlife/tours/ecuador/), if the selection suits the kind of journey you want.

**Adventure activities.** A zipline crosses the forest canyon on cables, a suspended crossing above the trees allows visitors to observe the forest from a height, and tubing takes place on a river. These are different activities with different participant requirements. Check the day-by-day itinerary and included services, especially when an activity is listed as optional.

**Onward travel.** After Mindo, the journey may continue to Ecuador's volcanic regions, the Amazon or the Galápagos Islands. Several itineraries combine a nature day in Mindo with the [Galápagos Islands](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/), but the time allocated to mainland Ecuador and the islands varies.

## Preparing for the Trip

Rain and humidity are possible in cloud forest even when Quito is dry. Shoes with good grip, a lightweight waterproof jacket and protection for electronics are useful on walks. If your program includes ziplining or tubing, consider participants' ages, physical fitness and personal limitations beforehand.

When choosing dates, take your interest in birds, trail conditions and the other parts of your journey into account. Some routes focus on wildlife observation; others combine forest experiences with high-altitude trekking. Also compare [all Ecuador tours](/ecuador/tour/) to assess the trip as a whole.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours Through Mindo

### Can You Visit Mindo from Quito in One Day?

Yes. Several Ada Tours programs include it as a separate excursion day with a return to Quito. For longer walks and early birdwatching, choose an itinerary with an overnight stay in the cloud forest area.

### Do All Mindo Tours Include Ziplining?

No. Ziplining is explicitly included in some adventure itineraries. Others emphasize butterflies, orchids, forest trails and birds. Check the specific day's program.

### Which Is Better: Mindo or Bellavista?

[Mindo](/ecuador/place/mindo/) offers a variety of day-trip activities, while [Bellavista](/ecuador/place/bellavista-cloud-forest/) serves as a base for overnight stays, early observations and cloud forest walks in several current tours. Longer itineraries visit both areas in sequence.

### Can Mindo Be Combined with the Galápagos?

Yes. Such combinations feature among current [Ecuador tours](/ecuador/tour/), including 8-day and longer programs. Compare the number of days on the mainland and islands, flight arrangements and separate paid fees described in the selected tour.
